description: Set environment variables based on service or login context. Enables conditional behavior based on login origin (local vs remote).

parameter_help.conffile: Configuration file with environment variable definitions
parameter_help.readenv: Set to 0 to disable reading from file

use_cases: Set different PATH for different services
Configure shell behavior based on login type
shell_usage: Variables available in shell scripts via $VARIABLE_NAME
benefits: Simple way to detect login origin
notes: Commonly used with conditional shell logic. Example: if [ "$LOGIN_ORIGIN" = "remote" ]; then ...
